messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Dedicated pool alert for pool=dedpool-11 (customer=MarinaCorp, vpc=mari-vpc-2). Node gpu-42 reporting repeated ECC errors + kernel oops, counts spiking. Suspected hardware failure. Auto-eviction attempted and failed twice. Please ack and triage. severity=P1

nina (oncall): acked. I'm jumping on this. Can someone confirm if any running tenant jobs impacted right now?

meera (infra): I see partial evictions on gpu-42, 5 pods failed to checkpoint. Tenant tag marinacorp-embeddings had 3 active replicas on that node. Autoscaler attempted warm-replace but pool currently at 95% utilization, warm-reserve not enough. Logs: `GPU ECC spike: 0x3A, AER corrected=2, uncorrected=7`

nina (oncall): thanks. @santiago can you be on customer comms? @tom please prepare node drain plan, we might need immediate tenant isolation.

tom (sre): On it. Quick mitigation checklist: 1) cordon+drain node gpu-42, 2) isolate marinacorp tenant from scheduling to that pool, 3) route their traffic to dedpool-12 warm standby, 4) if capacity insufficient, enable fallback to CPU-limited model. Executing step 1 now:

```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-42 -n ded-pools
kubectl drain gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data -n ded-pools
```

ops-bot: drain started for node gpu-42; 3 pods evicted, 2 pods failed graceful termination and restarted on same node (OOM). Eviction retries left=1.

meera (infra): The failed graceful terminations look like model-inference workers that hold GPU memory. Adding `--force` would kill but risk model corruption. Recommend tenant isolation first so we can reschedule to dedpool-12 without forcing.

nina (oncall): Agree. santiago, can you confirm with MarinaCorp whether brief degraded latency is ok? We need permission to divert to dedpool-12 which may be in a different AZ — cross-AZ egress might affect their compliance setting.

santiago (solutions): pinging marinacorp-ops now. MarinaCorp-ops: @marinacorp-ops are you available? We have node gpu-42 in your dedicated pool with hardware ECC/unrecoverable errors. We plan to isolate your tenant from dedpool-11 and fail traffic to dedpool-12 (same region, different AZ). Expected 30-60s failover per connection; telemetry may show increased tail latency ~200-300ms for embedding calls. Need your OK to proceed.

marinacorp-ops (customer): thanks for the heads up. We can accept a short performance hit. Prefers no egress across regions — same region is fine. Do you have an ETA to restore capacity?

nina (oncall): ETA: next healthy node available in dedpool-12 within 5 minutes if cordon/drain succeed. We'll also spin up a replacement in dedpool-11 but that may take ~12-15 minutes. Proceeding with isolation now.

meera (infra): Implementing tenant isolation rule (placement policy) for tenant=marinacorp to deny scheduling on dedpool-11. Applying taint on nodes in dedpool-11 for `dedpool=dedpool-11:NoSchedule` scoped to marinacorp avoids broad disruption. Applying change:

```yaml
# placement override for marinacorp until gpu-42 removed
apiVersion: v1
kind: PodTolerationPolicy
metadata:
  name: marinacorp-temp-isolate
spec:
  tenant: marinacorp
  deniedPools: ["dedpool-11"]
```

ops-bot: placement override applied for tenant=marinacorp; scheduling stopped on dedpool-11.

tom (sre): Now attempting re-schedule of 3 evicted pods to dedpool-12. Observed two succeeded, one pending due to ephemeral disk not found error. Restarting the job with checkpoint fallback.

nina (oncall): Good. Monitoring traffic shift metrics: 95% of requests routing to dedpool-12 within 40s. Error rate for marinacorp embeddings peaked at 8% during eviction window, now trending down to 0.8%.

meera (infra): We've marked gpu-42 as quarantined. Hardware team ingestion ticket created: HT-7421. They will attempt PSR BMC reset but this looks like memory bus errors; replacement node likely needed. Spare availability: dedpool-11 has 1 spare in provisioning, ETA to join pool ~14 minutes.

santiago (solutions): Customer notified: we requested they'll monitor and escalate if SLAs are missed. They asked for a short status blurb for their internal ops — I've sent an incident summary including times and mitigation steps.

marinacorp-ops (customer): appreciate the fast turnaround. Please send post-incident summary and whether any inference outputs were affected (duplicates/corruption).

nina (oncall): We'll run a quick integrity check on recent embedding batches for marinacorp and report if we see corruption. Early checks show no checksum mismatches for completed jobs.

tom (sre): Post-mitigation: node drained successfully with `--force` fallback avoided. Replacement spawn for dedpool-11 started (provision task ID prov-9983). Confirmed all marinacorp replicas running on dedpool-12.

ops-bot: auto-fallback to CPU-model not triggered. Warm-standby handled load.

meera (infra): Hardware team updated HT-7421: PSU and PCIe riser looks ok, uncorrected ECC suggests GPU DIMM failure. RMA recommended. We'll schedule replacement during the maintenance window unless customer requests immediate physical swap.

nina (oncall): Quick TL;DR for timeline (for ticket): 2512345678 initial pager -> cordon/drain started at +00:45s -> tenant isolation applied +01:30s -> traffic shifted to dedpool-12 +02:10s -> all replicas healthy +03:15s. Impact: short error spike (peak 8%), tail latency bump for ~2m, no data corruption found.

santiago (solutions): Customer confirmed acceptable. Logging follow-up items: 1) add more warm reserve to dedpool-11 for marinacorp customers, 2) improve graceful shutdown hooks in inference workers to reduce force kills, 3) automation to preemptively delay scheduling of heavy long-running jobs onto single node. I'll open ops tickets for each.

tom (sre): I'll add an emergency runbook entry for `gpu-ecc-unrecovered` that covers tenant isolation + warm-failover steps. Also adding a check to trigger earlier warm-reserve scaling at 85% util for enterprise pools.

meera (infra): Creating RMA plan and tagging node gpu-42 for hardware swap. HT-7421 -> assigned to hw-team oncall.

nina (oncall): closing on-call actions. If anything regresses ping `#incidents` and I'll re-open pager. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

marinacorp-ops (customer): thanks everyone, good handling. We'll await postmortem and keep this ticket open until hardware replaced.

incident-bot: incident thread auto-logged. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 at 2512345940 after full tenant failover and stabilization.
